audit.why: Justice Punch (E) is a dash/knockup, not a projectile — Wind Wall only blocks projectiles, i.e. Winds of War (Q). The taunt is Shield of Durand (W). Your only setup is the second Steel Tempest whirlwind. Mirror audit reached the same conclusion.
